definition: one hard conversation with Jen about connection, in the order it actually ran

settled:
I had been in and out of a mild cold, and the day before was worse.

Around half past ten I found her in the shower. She was sore from swimming and told me the whole story of getting our daughter through a hard swim lesson, about thirty minutes. I listened without losing my thread and did not back-channel enough, so she felt tolerated more than listened to. The second yellow flag I missed.

She had an appointment to collect two hundred and fifty pounds of cleaned, sorted Lego she had found for me, for Lego art against my creativity scars. She suggested we talk on the drive. These talks go better on the phone, me walking and her colouring, so I sat in the back seat to break the stress loop. The third flag.

I opened with connection as a homeostatic need and loneliness as load on my nervous system. It was new to her, so she wrestled with it, her normal process. My brain read the wrestling as criticism and I went into fight or flight. The red flag I went past.

title: The Talk In The Car On 8 June 2026
